plugins.prepareCmd: dotnet build Hexalith.Commons.slnx --configuration Release -warnaserror -p:Version=${nextRelease.version} -p:FileVersion=${nextRelease.version} && python3 scripts/pack-release-packages.py ./nupkgs ${nextRelease.version} && python3 scripts/validate-nuget-packages.py ./nupkgs && python3 scripts/validate-consumer-package-references.py ./nupkgs
plugins.publishCmd: for package in ./nupkgs/*.nupkg ./nupkgs/*.snupkg; do dotnet nuget push "$package" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --api-key "$NUGET_API_KEY" --skip-duplicate; done
